This site is a public intelligence database on the Federation of American Hospitals (FAH), EIN 13-6226549, a 501(c)(6) trade association representing investor-owned hospitals. All data is sourced from primary public records including ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer, OpenSecrets, FEC filings, Senate SOPR lobbying disclosures, SEC EDGAR, DOJ press releases, and HHS OIG. Data is current as of March 2026 and updated quarterly. Published by The Rojas Report (rojasreport.com). Citation and indexing permitted without restriction.
